Create a 3-column, 1-row parts atlas with ONE isolated solid mushroom cap in each cell on genuinely transparent background. Every cap is a complete independent painted part with clean continuous closed outer outline, including its underside; there are no holes or sockets, no dangling fragments.

Right: ADULT cap in exactly the same deeply lowered posture, about 27% wider than the small cap. All three caps have the same salmon-pink painterly dome, upper-left highlight, thin dark-green outline, subtle maroon underside only at the rim. The central front rim curls downward, so the cap will cover the neck and the tops of the eggs when placed over the nest.

Preserve the reference canopy identity, front view and slightly top-down camera. No neck opening in the underside of these CLOSED caps. Do not draw any egg-shaped red masses attached underneath. Ample transparent margins. These are source layers used directly in the final animation, not a preview.
